O.location: plot, mark above x-axis tick labeled 2005
O.content: A black point is aligned with the printed x-axis label "2005" and has the printed inscription "23.9" above it.

O.location: plot, rightmost mark above x-axis tick labeled 2014
O.content: A black point is aligned with the printed x-axis label "2014" and has the printed inscription "10.1" above it.
The chart title is "Reservoir Storage Level Index"; the horizontal axis is labeled "Year" and the vertical axis is labeled "Storage index".

B.text: The x-axis year labels attach the endpoint marks to 2005 and 2014, and the numeric inscriptions beside those marks are their storage-index values. Subtracting the 2014 value from the 2005 value yields the full-period index change. Routing to substantial-change follow-up is warranted only if that computed change meets the applicable substantial-change criterion; no numeric criterion is supplied in the task or chart.
B.conditions: Assumes the endpoint inscriptions represent the Reservoir Storage Level Index values for their adjacent year marks. The proposed routing additionally assumes a 13.8-point decrease qualifies as substantial under an unstated program criterion.
